recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-32488. Treat any future THO migration or reusable terminology cleanup as separate follow-up under FHIR-55335 or another final terminology-management decision.
issue_request: FHIR-32488 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked Pharmacy to replace the broad, unrealistic performer role value set used by MedicationPrescription/MedicationRequest with a small exemplar subset such as Registered Nurse, Oncology Nurse, Pain Control Nurse, Physician, and Pharmacist.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation. Commit 3eb5717 changed MedicationRequest.performerType from an example binding to the broad ValueSet/performer-role to an extensible binding to ValueSet/medication-intended-performer-role, and commit bd922b20 added the dedicated value set and code system with the five exemplar codes. Later terminology metadata/OID cleanup retained the binding and code content.
additional_context: MedicationRequest is active in source/fhir.ini. The May 2021 Pharmacy WGM minutes corroborate the small-subset decision. Later FHIR-55335 is Triaged/Unresolved and considers possible THO migration for several MedicationRequest value sets, including medication-intended-performer-role, but it is not a final content-changing decision for this seed.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current authoritative source already binds MedicationRequest.performerType to medication-intended-performer-role and defines only registerednurse, oncologynurse, paincontrolnurse, physician, and pharmacist in that code system.

related_jiras.note: Later Triaged/Unresolved issue considers THO migration for MedicationRequest value sets, including medication-intended-performer-role, but does not alter the FHIR-32488 subset decision.
